children: Nifty 50 began today’s session with a gap-up at 23,335 versus Thursdays’ close of 23,271. The index is now hovering around 23,300, up 0.15 per cent.

The advance/decline ratio of Nifty 50 now stands at 28/22, showing a slight positive bias. Dr Reddy’s Laboratories and InterGlobe Aviation, up 1.9 per cent each, are the top gainers whereas Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Tata Consultancy Services, down 2.9 per cent and 2.5 per cent respectively, are the top losers.
Barring Nifty IT (down 1.3 per cent) and Nifty Consumer Durables (down 0.4 per cent), all other sectors are in the green. Nifty Realty and Nifty Media, up 1.5 per cent each, top the charts.
While the above factors give a positive bias, the chart shows that Nifty 50 and Nifty futures are now facing a resistance that can cap the upside.
Nifty (Sep) futures began today’s session higher at 23,380 against yesterday’s close of 23,333. The contract is now trading at 23,340.
From an intraday perspective, the contract faces a notable resistance at 23,400. Until this level holds, the likelihood of a fresh downswing will be high.
A fall from the current level of 23,340 can drag Nifty futures to 23,200. Support below 23,200 is at 23,100.
Instead, if the September futures gather enough strength to break out of the resistance at 23,400, it can extend the rally to 23,500. But as it stands, an uptick beyond 23,400 is unlikely.
Short Nifty (Sep) futures now at 23,340. Target and stop-loss can be 23,200 and 23,420 respectively.

title: Nifty Prediction Today – September 18, 2026: Nifty futures: Resistance ahead
